Median Absolute Slopes Banking Let aspect ratio \(\alpha = \frac{w}{h}\) median absolute slop banking \(\alpha\) , $$   median \left| \frac{s_i}{\alpha} \right| = 1 $$ Let \(R_z = z_{max} - z_{min}\) \(z = x, y\), \(M = median \| s_i \|\). , $$ \alpha = M \frac{R_x}{R_y} $$ Average Absolute Slope Banking Let aspect ratio \(\alpha = \frac{w}{h}\). mean absolute slope banking \(\alpha\) , $$   mean \left| \frac{s_i}{\alpha} \right| = 1 $$ Average Absolute Orientation Banking Rather averaging slopes , method averages orientation (angle) segment, since perceived slope differences closely related angle raw ratio \(dy/dx\). Let \(s'_i = s_i R_x / R_y\) range-normalized slopes. \(\alpha\) chosen , $$   mean \left| \arctan \left( \frac{s'_i}{\alpha} \right) \right| = \frac{\pi}{4} $$ closed-form solution found numerically uniroot.
